pages.title: Source
pages.text: Maps formation catalogs, formation items and formation techniques: aura gathering, maze, killing, defense, seal, teleport, thunder and mountain-ward arrays.

pages.title: Playable Now
pages.text: Place seeking_immortals:spirit_gathering_array to inspect aura. Portable spirit-gather disks deploy a free field and only consume on success; spirit sand extends duration after activation. A full 13×13 gathering floor still forms the realm-gate array used by worldpack travel.

pages.title: Free Fields
pages.text: FormationFieldService owns free fields and ring arrays. Secret-realm traps, aura fields and mission deployments share server-side checks for place, materials, realm, cooldown and cost.

pages.title: Learning Hooks
pages.text: Formation manuals, foundation Formation Sense and sword-array combat hooks are live. Contribution halls can stock the current manual carriers.

pages.title: Still Deferred
pages.text: High-fidelity flag art, mountain-ward spectacle and a full formation specialist tree remain polish. Authority and fuel semantics are already transactional.
